contract.name: Exclusive All Market Promotional Rate – Summer & Winter 2026/27
contract.cancellation_text: Cancelation policy: Group bookings one-month prior notice. FIT bookings seven days prior notice.
contract.payment_text: Payment terms: payments on booked basis to be settled prior to guest arrival if not credit approved.
contract.notes: Transcribed from "Mirage Kandyan Heights New rate 2026- 2027 Summer & Winter rate.pdf" (2 pages), saved to the HOTEL RATES folder on 2 Oct 2026. No date printed on the sheet (PDF file created 16 Feb 2026). Travel Agent – Local Travel Agents; Market – All Market FIT & GIT; Period – Summer & Winter 2026/27; "4-star properties". The sheet calls itself an "Exclusive All Market Promotional Rate" but it is the full 12-month rate with all terms and no booking window, so it is entered as the contract. SGL/DBL is one price per room (entered in both SGL and DBL); TPL = DBL + the printed TPL BB / HB supplement (US$35) for the Deluxe room; N/A = no triple rate (Deluxe Triple and Deluxe Family). "DELUXE DRIPLE" in the Nov–Apr table is a typo for Deluxe Triple (the May–Oct table prints "DELUXE TRIPLE"). FB is derived (HB + lunch US$13 p.p.). Extra bed US$20 per night. Kandy Perahera supplement US$35 per room per night: the sheet gives no dates, so it is entered without dates as an optional supplement — add the Perahera nights when known. Christmas gala is not marked compulsory on this sheet (New Year gala is). If required, group lunch or dinner for Indian national guests US$12 pp at a separate location.
contract.tax_note: Sheet does not say whether taxes are included (no tax line); treated as nett/inclusive. Non-commissionable; any tax changes made by the government apply.
contract.child_policy_text: Child meal policy: 1 Child below 05 years sharing with parents FOC. Children between 06 to 11 years sharing with parents 50% of adult meal rate chargeable. Children at the age 12 & above Adult meal rate chargeable and count as Adult.
contract.guide_policy_text: Local Guide Room Rate USD 60 on booked basis.
contract.foc_policy_text: FOC policy: Every 11th room 1 room FOC on booked basics [basis]. Every 16th person ½ a double FOC (Guest or tour leader or local guide). Local Guide Room Rate USD 60 on booked basis.
contract.terms_text: Please note that above non-commissionable rates and any tax changes made by the government will be applicable for the above.
